cross_version_findings.V014: Order key permits ties: (creada_en, CASE estado_anterior, estado_nuevo, COALESCE(estado_anterior), motivo) is not unique; V011 only gives transition id uniqueness, not uniqueness of these fields. If already applied, do not rewrite; examine consumer semantics/data at each target read-only and assess forward correction only if observable wrong sequence is demonstrated. V085 cannot change which row_number tie order historical V014 assigned; can only establish a new invariant/resequence with explicit policy after proof, not repair historical precondition implicitly.
cross_version_findings.V015: Backfill JOIN drops quote rows lacking espacio_caracteristicas (and/or matching espacio); setting three columns NOT NULL then fails. Later V085 cannot run if V015 aborts in sequence. Need verify historical data/contract source or authorized preflight; if absent only in synthetic scenario, add migration test. A post-V015 migration cannot fix a V015 precondition that prevents it reaching V085.
